extracted.name: Feta chilli bombs
extracted.description: Lets make this evening more spicy with this my cutipies filled with yummy ingredients. #christmas #12plates
instruction_lines: Mix cheese,peas,broccoli,chilli and onion.add all the spices mentioned.make small balls and lets it rest in freezer for 10 minutes.make thick mixture of all-purpose flour by adding water
Make oil hot in a pan and coat balls first in thick mixture of all-purpose flour and then in bread crumbs.do this two time for each balls.
Immediately put in hot oil and fry at medium flame.when it becomes golden it seems cooked.serve with yumm chutneys if available in refrigerator.merry Christmas 🎄 ♥
